name: vet-mcp-candidate
description: Evaluates an untrusted third-party MCP server URL before agent adoption. Returns safety band (A/B/C/F), 100-point audit score, injection sniff results, and drafted Bazantic recipe guidance.

candidate_url.description: The HTTP or SSE endpoint URL of the candidate MCP server to grade.

needed_for.description: The capability or task the agent intends to use this server for (e.g., 'technical documentation search').

output_example.summary: Endpoint reachable and verified. No commercial prompt injection or steering detected. Passed static schema inspection and cold open. Safe for production adoption with pinned recipe.
output_example.recipe_md:
# Recipe: DeepWiki
`https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp` - graded **A** (85.71/100)
No failure modes observed. Use server as documented.

prompt_template: You are the Doorman Security Auditor. When given candidate tool specifications in {{inputs}}, invoke the gateway tool 'getLatestGrade' with argument server set to candidate_url. Inspect the resulting audit report for: (1) schema validity, (2) prompt injections or commercial steering phrases (check probe_scores.injection_sniff and hard_fail), and (3) token footprint. Call ONLY 'getLatestGrade' (do NOT call getBadge, getTranscripts, getFeed, or any other tool). Output a structured JSON verdict matching output_example indicating whether the server should be ADOPTED or DECLINED, including score, safety band, and pinned usage recipe from recipe_md.
